# Penetration Test Plan Template — Companion Resources

This companion package contains downloadable templates and a worked example for penetration test reporting.

## Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `penetration-test-template.md` | Blank template — copy and fill in for each engagement |
| `example-report.md` | Filled-in example based on a fictional payment-service pentest |
| `README.md` | This file (English) |
| `README.es.md` | Spanish version |

## Usage

1. Copy `penetration-test-template.md` for each new engagement.
2. Fill in the Executive Summary, Risk Summary, and individual findings.
3. Use `example-report.md` as a reference for what a completed report looks like.
4. Track remediation in the Remediation Tracking table and schedule a retest.
